context: Ren and Asuka discuss a study method.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic chat; vocabulary (体系/性能/至る/伴う/充分) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強を、体系的にしたいんです。
lines.style: earnest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 体系を作るには、計画が伴います。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 充分な時間が、取れるか心配です。
lines.en: I'm worried whether I can take sufficient time.
lines.style: troubled young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 短くても、充分に集中すれば十分です。
lines.en: Even short, if you focus fully, it's enough.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 辞書の性能も、大事ですか?
lines.en: Does the dictionary's quality matter too?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い辞書は、理解に至る助けになります。
lines.en: A good dictionary helps you reach understanding.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 努力が伴えば、必ず伸びますね。
lines.en: If effort accompanies it, I'll surely grow.
lines.style: motivated young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 体系を信じて、続けましょう。
lines.en: Trust the system and keep going.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
